folder_html:
LIVE SOLAR RADIATION

Surface downward shortwave solar radiation flux: solar power arriving at the surface, hourly-averaged for the model analysis hour. Nighttime reads zero (valid data, deep blue) — not missing data. Clouds reduce values quantitatively versus clear sky.

Surface downward shortwave solar radiation (W/m^2, hourly-averaged for the analysis hour), continuous: LOWEST 0 (dark blue) → common 0 → HIGHEST+ 787.6 (deep purple). Night reads zero; clouds reduce values quantitatively.
